excerpt.zh: Claude追溯NIST ECDSA曲线种子的生成方式，发现它们来自以Unix时间戳初始化的旧式伪随机数生成器，而非哈希算法。
excerpt.en: Claude traced NIST ECDSA seeds to a timestamp-seeded legacy PRNG, making deliberate backdoors less plausible while leaving several origins unresolved.

text.zh: Claude ECDSA追踪破解多年谜题
text.en: Claude’s ECDSA Investigation Solves a Longstanding Mystery

text.zh: Claude ECDSA研究追溯了NIST多条椭圆曲线种子的来源。Anthropic称，P-192、P-224、P-256、P-384、P-521及部分ANSI曲线的种子，并不是此前猜测的短语哈希，而是由20世纪90年代C库中的lrand48伪随机数生成器产生，并以Unix时间戳作为初始化值。
text.en: The Claude ECDSA investigation traced the origins of seeds used by several NIST elliptic curves. Anthropic says the seeds for P-192, P-224, P-256, P-384, P-521, and related ANSI curves were not hashes of a humorous phrase. Instead, they came from the lrand48 pseudorandom number generator found in 1990s-era C libraries, initialized with Unix timestamps.

text.zh: 结果支持曲线没有明显后门
text.en: What the ECDSA Finding Means for Security

text.zh: 研究人员通过识别旧式线性同余生成器的输出模式，恢复了内部状态，并重现了完整种子。这个结果不是对ECDSA的攻击，也没有要求用户更换密钥或调整部署方式。相反，公开、简单且可复现的生成过程，让人为植入特定弱点的解释变得不太可信，也增强了对这些参数安全性的信心。
text.en: By recognizing patterns from the old linear congruential generator, the researchers recovered internal states and regenerated the complete seeds. This is not an attack on ECDSA, and it does not require users to replace keys or change deployments. Rather, a simple and reproducible generation process makes deliberate insertion of a weakness less plausible and increases confidence in the parameters.

text.zh: 仍有未解的曲线来源问题
text.en: Important Open Questions Around the Curves

text.zh: Claude还找到了六条早期曲线部分基点的生成线索：它们与FreeLIP及相关整数运算代码中的随机数流程相符。但P-224、P-256、P-384、P-521的基点，以及NIST二元曲线的基点，仍未解释；B-163种子也没有匹配成功。研究还发现少数候选曲线被跳过，却无法确定筛选标准，因此这项发现更像是重要的溯源进展，而不是所有历史疑问的终点。
text.en: Claude also found clues for how base points of six early curves were generated, matching a random-number procedure in FreeLIP and related integer-arithmetic code. However, the base points for P-224, P-256, P-384, and P-521 remain unexplained, as do those of the NIST binary curves; the B-163 seed also resisted recovery. A few viable candidate curves were skipped, but the selection criteria are unknown. The result is therefore a major provenance advance, not a complete resolution of every historical question.

text.zh: 最重要的限制是，时间戳和伪随机数的重现只能说明这些数值如何产生，不能证明当年所有选择都完全没有人为判断。现有证据也没有显示这些曲线存在可利用的后门。研究团队表示，奖金将捐给Internet Security Research Group。
text.en: The key limitation is that reproducing timestamps and PRNG output explains how the values could have been produced, but cannot prove that every historical choice was free of human judgment. The available evidence also shows no exploitable backdoor in the curves. Anthropic said the discovery bounty will be donated to the Internet Security Research Group.
